highlights.title: The built-in reader joins your devices
highlights.text: It opens where your Kobo or KOReader stopped, to the paragraph, and KOReader continues from the browser. Time spent reading in it counts in your statistics.

highlights.title: Highlights everywhere
highlights.text: Highlight and add notes in the browser. Your Kobo and KOReader highlights appear in the book, browser highlights reach KOReader, and a highlight deleted in KOReader or in the browser goes from both.

highlights.title: A passage of the day
highlights.text: One of your highlights at the top of the home page, a different one each day. Turn it off in your profile if you prefer.

highlights.title: A friendlier first start
highlights.text: New installations no longer ship with admin / admin123: you create your account in the browser, then a short tour shows you around.

highlights.title: Update the KOReader plugin
highlights.text: Version 1.3 follows the built-in reader and brings its highlights to your device. Download it again from Profile → Devices; Scriptorium reminds you until every device has it.

quote.text: To produce a mighty book, you must choose a mighty theme.
quote.author: Herman Melville

highlights.title: Reading statistics
highlights.text: Reading time, streaks, a calendar of your year and your habits, shared between all your KOReader devices.

highlights.title: A richer year in books
highlights.text: Real reading time from KOReader, your reading clock, the book you lived in and your biggest reading day.

highlights.title: Highlights from every device
highlights.text: KOReader on a Kobo and on a phone keep their highlights side by side: a sync from one no longer removes the other's.

highlights.title: Update the KOReader plugin
highlights.text: Version 1.2 brings statistics sync and works with menus such as ZenOS. Download it again from Profile → Devices; Scriptorium reminds you until every device has it.

quote.text: As if you could kill time without injuring eternity.
quote.author: Henry David Thoreau

highlights.title: Your year in books
highlights.text: A full-screen story of your reading year, with a poster to save and share.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.text: Every passage and note from your Kobo or KOReader on one page, exportable to Markdown.

highlights.title: Your reading devices
highlights.text: Choose Kobo, KOReader or both in Profile → Devices. Progress from either shows on every book.

highlights.title: Bring your history
highlights.text: Import what you read on Goodreads or The StoryGraph, with dates and your want-to-read list.

highlights.title: An app, and books like this one
highlights.text: Install Scriptorium on your home screen, share books to it, and find similar books on every book page.

quote.text: I declare after all there is no enjoyment like reading!
quote.author: Jane Austen

highlights.title: A new interface
highlights.text: Every page redesigned, in light and dark, and built for phones as much as desktops.

highlights.title: Your own colours
highlights.text: Open Customize from your account menu: eleven ready-made styles, a random mix or your own palette.

highlights.title: Kobo-first
highlights.text: A guided Kobo setup on your profile, and Continue reading fed by your device.

highlights.title: Better readers
highlights.text: An EPUB reader with themes and typography settings, and an audiobook player that remembers where you stopped.

highlights.title: Safer by default
highlights.text: A strict Content-Security-Policy, CSRF protection on every action and a new password at first sign-in.

quote.text: Begin at the beginning, and go on till you come to the end: then stop.
quote.author: Lewis Carroll
